tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar rgyas pa bzhugs so/ /bstod pa tshigs bcad ma dang sgo bstun na legs 'dug/ na mo/ dharmā rā dza/ dharmā swa mi/ dharmā+e shwa ri/ ma hā gu ru/ ā nan+da/ maṃ ga la/ dh+wa dza shrī bha dra/ pa tā la ban dha naṃ ka ro mi/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam par thar pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul nye bar mtshon byed ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i gter zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis bskal pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol du/ /bsod nams ye shes kun nas mthar son pas/ /srid gsum 'gran zla bral ba'i go 'phang brnyes/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blang / /nyid kyi phrin las ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /bdag blo'i snyim pas gzhal bar mi nus kyang / /dad ldan lhag bsam bum pa 'gengs pa'i slad/ /rnam thar byin brlabs rgyun 'di rol par mdzod// //'dir bdag cag gi bla ma chos kyi rje dmigs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab dang / thugs rjer ldan pa 'di nyid nges pa'i don du dpal ldan stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par snang la/ nges pa dang ma nges pa'i gdul bya phal mo che rnams la/ sprul pa mchog dang mchog ma yin pa'i rnam par snang zhing / khyad par 'os su gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams la mi'i gzugs kyi tshul bstan pa yin te/ ji skad du/ rdo rje sems dpa' ji lta bu'i/ /de ltar slob dpon gzugs 'dzin ste/ /sems can rjes su gzung dmigs nas/ /phal pa'i gzugs su gnas pa 'o/ /zhes pa la sogs pas lung dang / rig pas legs par grub pa yin no/ /'di la/ spyir chos bzhi ste/ 'jig rten pa dang thun mong gi rnam par thar pa/ nyan thos dang thun mong gi rnam par thar pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dang thun mong gi rnam par thar pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang thun mong gi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar che ba'i lo rgyus dang bzhi/

dang po ni/ che ba'i yon tan bdun gyis mngon par 'phags pas/ skyes bu dam pa 'di/ 'jig rten na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba yin te/ ji skad du/ rigs ldan gzugs bzang longs spyod che/ /shes rab phun tshogs dbang phyug ldan/ /nad med shin tu tshe ring bas/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun dang ldan/ /zhes pa ltar mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun las/ dang po rigs phun sum tshogs pa ni/ 'jig rten na mi'i rigs bzhir grags pa las/ mchog tu gyur pa rgyal rigs/ rje rigs/ bram ze'i rigs gsum yin la/ de'i nang nas rje 'di nyid rigs rnams kyi bla ma rje rigs/ rus rnams kyi mchog 'khon gyi gdung lha'i rgyud/ cho 'brang rnams kyi mchog mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa mthu dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa sha stag rim par byon pa'i rgyud do/ /de'i bsdoms ni/ lha'i rigs las mi yi rjer gyur pa/ /bcu phrag zung dang bzhi yis lhag pa'i rgyud/ /gnam lha g.yu rings ma sangs mthu bo che/ /dpa' bo stag dang klu tsha 'od chen dang / /de sras g.ya' spang skyes zhes grags pa gang / /thog mar byung ba lha yi gdung rabs lnga/ /'khon bar skyes dang de sras dpal po che/ /rdo rje rin chen shes rab yon tan dang / /tshul khrims rgyal po gtsug tor shes rab dang / /dge skyabs dge mthong 'khon ston bal po dang / /shākya blo gros zhes byar grags pa rnams/ /bar du byung ba 'khon gyi gdung rabs bcu/ /dkon mchog rgyal po kun dga' snying po dang / /dpal chen 'od po de sras zangs tshar grags/ ye shes 'byung gnas dang ni bzang po dpal/ /sa skyong cod pan kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /gnas lnga rig pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan rnams/ /dpal ldan sa skyar byon pa'i gdung rabs brgyad/ /lha yi gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ /slar yang 'khon gyi gdung rabs bcu dgu pa/ /sa skya 'khon gyi gdung rabs dgu pa la/ /rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po khyed rnams so/

/de yang gdung rabs dang po gnam lha mched gsum/ mi yul du byon pa'i bar pa gnam lha g.yu rings las gyes/ gdung rabs gnyis pa ma sangs mched bdun byon pa'i tha chung las gyes/ gdung rabs brgyad pa mched gnyis byon pa'i gcung rdo rje rin chen las gyes/ dgu pa 'bro tsha mched bdun byon pa'i tha ltag shes rab yon tan las gyes/ bcu pa mched gnyis kyi gcen tshul khrims rgyal po las gyes/ bcu gcig pa mched gsum gyi gcen gtsug tor shes las gyes/ bcu gnyis pa mched bdun gyi tha chung dge skyabs las gyes/ bcu gsum pa mched gsum gyi gcen dge mthong las gyes/ bcu drug pa mched gnyis kyi gcung dkon mchog rgyal po las gyes/ bco brgyad pa mched bzhi las gcung dpal chen 'od po las gyes/ bcu dgu pa mched gnyis kyi gcung zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan las gyes/ nyi shu pa mched bzhi las/ bar pa slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas las gyes/ nyer gnyis pa mched bcu gnyis sam bcu gsum byon pa'i bar pa/ ti shrī chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po las gyes/ nyer gsum pa/ 7gong ma mi'i mchod gnas mched gnyis byon pa'i gcen gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ta'i dbon gau shrī chen po chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa las/ gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa sras mched bzhi byon pa'i sras kyi thu bo ni rje 'di nyid do/ /de ltar yab de nyid dang / yum spyi'i chu 'dor byon pa la gcig rgyal mo bsod nams 'bum kyang zer ba 'dug 'tsho zhes pa las/ sa mo glang gi lo dpyid zla ra ba la/ rje 'di nyid ngo mtshar ba'i bltas du ma dang bcas te/ dpal sa skya'i sde chen por bltams so/ /de yang / gzhon nu'i dus nas des pa dang / /gsong por smra zhing dul ba dang / /brtse ldan 'od gsal rgyun mi 'chad/ /'di dag cho rigs btsun pa'i brtags/ /gnam zer thog gis mi tshugs zhing /

/mthu rtsal gyad kyis mi bzod la/ /ngag gis gdon rnams skrag byed pa/ /'di dag 'khon gyi gdung las 'byung / /gzhung bzang khrel dang ngo tsha shes/ /ya rabs spyod tshul kun rdzogs shing / /rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang ldan/ /mi mchog khyed la bdag dad do/ /'od gsal rgyun mi 'chad pa'i lo rgyus ni/ bgres po rgyus can rnams zhal mthun par/ smra mkhyen nas dgung lo drug bdun gyi bar mnal mdzad pa'i ngang nas/ pha rol po dag gis ci smras pa dang / bya byed rnams thogs med du mkhyen nas gsungs pas/ kun ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa dang / rje nyid kyi sku zhang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gcig la dmar khrid gsan pa dang / mkhas grub 'phags pa la ne gu chos drug gi khrid gsan pas/ sngar gyi nyams snang phal mo che/ 'od gsal zin pa'i nyams su ngo 'phrod pa dang / dgung lo brgyad pa nas/ rmi lam zin pa/ sbyong spel/ sprul bsgyur/ zhing khams blta ba la sogs pa rmi lam gyi stobs shin tu che bar yod de/ de ka'i mu brgyud na/ rmi lam gyi grub chen gcig yong ba yod de/ sna mangs pas lan gsung / 'di tsam gsungs kyang rmi lam la dbang thob pa yin no/ /yang rje'i zhal nas/ da gzhon nu'i dus su mi rtag pa dang / nges 'byung gis kun nas bslangs pa'i za zi ban bun mang po byung ste/ phyis brtags pas nyams yin par dga' ba la zhes yang yang gsung ngo / /che ba'i yon tan gnyis pa gzugs phun sum tshogs pa ni/ 'khor 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus na bzhugs kyang / gzhan lhag par gzugs bzang ba rnams kyis bskrun par mi bzod de/ chu zheng gab cing brjid pa'i sku/ /zhal ras zla ba rgyas pa bzhin/ /spyan dkyus ut+pal gsal bu mtshungs/ /dpral dbyes zla ba tshes pa 'dra/ /'dzum bag 'od zer 'phro ba bzhin/ /sku stod seng ge'i 'phel kha mtshungs/ /'gros ni glang chen rol pa 'dra/ /blta bas mi ngoms khyod la 'dud/ /ces pa ltar mngon du gyur cing /

deng sang sku bgres par gyur kyang gzhon sha rgyas shing skra dkar nyung / gnyer ma mi mnga'/ sku la dri ma mi 'chags/ lhag par gzi mdangs che zhing tshul khrims kyi dri zhim po'i ngad pa 'phro/ zo mdog bde ba la sogs pa ngo mtshar du snang ba kun la gsal lo/ /che ba'i yon tan gsum pa longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa ni/ mchog gi longs spyod gser dngul dang / a ka ru nag po/ tsan+dan dkar dmar la sogs las grub pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten gzhal med khang la sogs pa rang nyid kyis bzhengs shing / gzhan gyis phul ba la sogs pa dpag tu med pa dang / btags sku/ skud ris/ bsi hu la sogs las grub pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i sku'i rten dang / gser las bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gsung gi rten/ gser gyi rdo rje dril bu sogs ngo mtshar ba'i thugs kyi rten dpag tu med pa rnams dang / de dag gi spyan sngar mchod pa'i rdzas la gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong ldan/ gser gyi bum pa/ gser gyi maṇ+ḍal bdun tshar sogs la re re'ang rin po che'i rigs mi 'dra ba du mas spras pa rnams dang / de bzhin du gu gu sha'i mchod rdzas dang / dam rdzas dpag tu med pa rnams dang / mu tig gi gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ mu tig gi rnam sbyar sogs dpag tu med pa rnams dang / gzhan yang za 'og na jus sogs dar zab rigs mi 'dra ba du ma las bsgrubs pa'i dar kha/ gur/ gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ ba dan/ yol ba sogs dpag tu med pa deb gter chen mor gsal ba rnams dang / thun mong gi longs spyod gser dngul bre chen/ rin po che bai ḍūr+ya/ man shel/ mu men/ spug byi ru/ mu tig thā na/ sa le sbram/ bse ru/ dung g.yas 'khyil sogs nor bu dang rin po che rigs du ma dang / gos zab dang dar zab dpag tu med pa dang / ja rta 'dzo gsum sogs rgya bod kyi zang zing gi longs spyod dpag tu med pa snga phyir phyag tu babs so/ /mdor na/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rten/

/dam tshig rdzas dang mchod pa'i rdzas/ /rin po che dang dar zab dang / /'bru dang rkang 'gro khang bzang sogs/ /thun mong ba dang phul byung ba'i/ /dpal 'byor mi bzad khyod la 'dud/ /che ba'i yon tan bzhi pa shes rab phun sum tshogs pa ji ltar mnga' ba ni/ gzhon nu nyid nas/ klog dang / yi ge dang / rtsis dang / brtag pa brgyad pa dang / lugs kyi bstan bcos la sogs pa'i gnad rnams dang / phyi nang gi rigs pa'i gnas phal mo che la ma rmongs shing / rnam par spyod pa'i shes rab dang spobs pa thogs pa med pa mnga' ste/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i mkhyen rab kyi rnam grangs dag gis shes par nus so/ /mdor na/ 'jig rten tshul lugs ji snyed pa/ /rgya chen rig pa'i gnas rnams la/ /skyes stobs dang ni sbyor byung gi /blo gros mtshungs bral khyod la 'dud/ /che ba'i yon tan lnga pa dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rje 'di nyid/ hor gyi dus nas/ gong gi lung dang gdan sa chen po'i bka' gros la dbang ba rnams dang / son wi si'i mi dpon rnams kyis lha khang bla brang du chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gdan sar mnga' gsol/ de nas bzung ste rgya bod hor gsum gyi rgyal po rgyal brgyud/ mi chen/ bshes gnyen chen po/ sde bdag rnams kyi phud du khur/ mchod gnas su 'dzin/ khyad par deng sang gong ma mi'i dbang po/ ta'i ming chos kyi rgyal po chen pos zhabs spyi bor blangs/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po zhes pa la sogs par mtshan gyi rnam grangs du mas thub pa'i rgyal tshab chen por mnga' gsol/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong ldan phul nas/ 'dzam bu'i gling du chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor bar gsol ba btab/ gzhan yang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po yongs su grags pa phal mo che rnams kyis kyang chos dang mthun par rgol bar mi nus shing / chos dang dam tshig gis sbrel ba'i slob mar gyur pa sha stag go

/mdor na sa'i steng gnam 'og na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral zhing kun la dbang bsgyur ba yin no/ /che dgu rnams kyis bka' bzhin dang du len/ /mkhas grub rnams kyi gtsug gi rgyan gyur la/ /sa steng 'di na 'gran pa'i zla dang bral/ /dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa khyod la 'dud/ /che ba'i yon tan drug pa nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rje 'di nyid sku tshe snga ma la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i mthus sku lus la nad kyi rigs gang gi'ang rkyen gyis ma gos shing / bskyod pa yang zo mdog bde la nad thams cad dang bral ba yin no/ /tshe rabs kun tu bzod pa goms pa'i mthus/ /rims dang nad sogs 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa yis/ /rnam pa kun tu bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba/ /bsnyun bral khyod la bdag cag lhag par dad/ /che ba'i yon tan bdun pa tshe ring ba phun sum tshogs pa ni/ tshe lo brgya pa'i dus 'dir/ de bzhin gshegs pa na tshod brgyad cu bzhes pa dang tshul mtshungs par bdag nyid chen po 'dis kyang / dgu lo bdun cu don bdun bzhugs/ rje'i zhal nas/ shangs phu'i zam 'tsher la kha na 'ja' 'od dpag tu med pa 'khyil zhing 'khrigs pa'i gseb na/ bud med mang pos bde ba can du byon zer ba sogs cho 'phrul mang po byung / de'i dus su 'dun pa byas/ khyed kyis lo brgyad cu thub zer ba'i lung bstan cig byung bas da bar bsdad/ da yun ring bsdod pa'i nges pa med gsung / gong la phyin pa'i dus/ rgyal po'i mi dpyad mkhan po na re/ khyod rus sbal gyi rigs yin pas/ lo brgyad cu thub zer gyin gda'/ na ning shi na kho la kha skyengs yong ba 'dug gsung / bde bar gshegs khar zhal nas/ da dung lo re tsam bsdod bsam pa yin na'ang / rten 'brel 'ga' zhig gis rgyus/ da lo 'gro bar 'dug khyed rang rnams rim 'gro byas ma byas ni med/ byed na'ang dbang che/ 'u cag tshe dang thos bsam sgom gsum phrin las thams cad mthar phyin pas/

mya ngan dang sems khral cung zad kyang ma byed/ gsol ba thob gsungs nas/ brgyad cu'i steng nas/ lo gsum thugs kyis 'phen pa btang ste/ bdun cu don bdun bzhugs so/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rim par byon pa rnams kyi nang nas/ rje 'di nyid las sku tshe ring ba ma byung ngo / /mdor na/ rigs dang / gzugs dang / 'byor pa dang / blo gros dang / dbang phyug dang / bsnyun med pa dang / sku tshe mthar phyin pa ste/ 'di ltar che ba'i yon tan bdun gyis lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten skye dgu rnams kyi nang na mngon par mtho zhing khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /spyi don gnyis pa/ nyan thos dang thun mong du sku che ba'i yon tan la/ gzhi tshul khrims la ji ltar gnas pa'i tshul/ klog pa thos bsam dang / spong ba bsam gtan la ji ltar bslab pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po gzhi tshul khrims la ji ltar gnas pa la/ dge bsnyen dang / dge tshul gyi sdom pa nod tshul/ dge slong gi sdom pa nod tshul lo/ /de dag rim pa bzhin/ sku na gzhon nu la tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs te/ dgung lo bco lnga bzhes pa'i dus su 'brug lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu la/ ta'i dben bzhi thog pa kun dga' rin chen pas mkhan po/ mkhas grub rin chen rdo rje bas slob dpon/ dad pa'i dge 'dun mang po dang bcas pa'i dbus su rab tu byung ste/ kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bar mtshan gsol nas/ dge tshul gyi sdom pas mdzes par byas/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi bzhes pa'i dus su/ chos rje bla ma dam pas mkhan po/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis las kyi slob dpon/ lo tsā ba byang chub rtse mos gsang ston gyi slob dpon/ dad pa'i dge 'dun bcu phrag zung dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ ngo mtshar ba'i bltas du ma dang bcas nas tshangs par spyod pa/ dge slong gi sdom pas mdzes par byas shing bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do/

/khyod ni bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /dge bsnyen dge tshul bsnyen par rdzogs/ /so sor thar pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /tshangs spyod mthar phyin khyod la 'dud/ /gnyis pa klog pa thos bsam la ji ltar bslab pa'i tshul ni/ lung dang rig pa'i gnad la legs par sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa dag bsten te/ rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel la sogs pa/ rigs pa dang lung gi bstan bcos du ma dag gsan sbyong mdzad nas/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por/ lo bco brgyad kyi bar du brtson pa dang ldan pa sde snod 'dzin pa 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs la/ 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa dang / rtsom pa gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po mdzad/ de dag gi thad du mtshan nyid pa'i bdag rkyen/ phyogs ris kyi grwa bskor ba rnams la gnang sbyin mdzad pa la sogs pa ni dpag tu med do/ /de dag gi bar skabs su/ phag mo gru pa 'jam dbyangs gau shrīs dbus su spyan drangs/ rtse thang gi chos grwa chen por rab tu sbyangs pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa rnams dang brtsod pas/ rje 'di nyid kun las rgyal ba'i lo rgyus bgres po rnams gsung zhing / zhal nas kyang / ngas rtse thang du phyin tsa na/ dge bshes mang pos mtha' bskor nas dri ba byas/ 'grel pa'i na ya mang pos rgal rtags byas/ lan btab pas khong thams cad mgu nas/ de'i dus ngas kyang tha snyad shes zer ba gcig yod pa yin gsung / gsum pa spong ba bsam gtan la ji ltar bslab pa ni/ gzhon nu nyid nas bag chags sad pa'i stobs kyis chos thams cad mi rtag pa/ sdug bsngal ba stong pa bdag med pa'i nyams bsam gyis mi khyab pa thugs la 'khrungs te/ de yang bar skabs su 'khor longs spyod mnga' ris thams cad rang rang tha dad du bkye zhing bor nas dben pa kho na la thugs gzhol bar mdzad do/ /de'i skabs nas 'jig rten gyi spros pa mtha' dag spangs pa'i zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis dus 'da' bar gyur to/

/de'i ngang nas/ rje 'di nyid las rab tu byung zhing / bsnyen par rdzogs te/ sdom pa nod pa stong phrag du ma dag 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ /spyi don gsum pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dang thun mong du sku che ba'i yon tan la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ji ltar nod pa'i tshul/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la ji ltar bslabs pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bla ma chen po bsod nams blo gros/ ta'i dben chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa rnams la/ dbu ma lugs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nod/ lo tsā ba chen po byang chub rtse mo la sogs pa rnams la/ sems tsam lugs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nod nas/ bslab pa gsum gyi brtul zhugs la gnas par mdzad/ gzhan gyi don du lhag bsam bslabs chen gyis/ /byang chub spyod pa bslabs chen rdzogs bgyi'i slad/ /byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs nye bar nod/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi thu bo khyod la 'dud/ /gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la ji ltar bslab pa'i tshul ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug las/ dang po sbyin pa la bslab pa ni/ ser sna med cing skal ba dang 'tshams par gtong ba la spro ba'i bdag nyid can zhig ste/ spyir zang zing gi sbyin pa/ chos kyi sbyin pa/ skyabs kyi sbyin pa/ byams pa'i sbyin pa bzhi/ dang po la/ sbyin pa'i yul mchog dang mchog ma yin pa gnyis/ mchog ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa/ de dag gi mchod rdzas/ dkar me khor yug gsung rab 'gyur ro cog gi gsung sgrog pa/ tsha tsha 'bum gter lo re bzhin du brlabs chen sgrub pa rnams dang / dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi dgon sde rnams na bzhugs pa'i mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho dang bcas pa rnams la/ rang rang gi thad du snga phyir bsnyen cing bskur ba dang /

khyad par gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar yang / snga phyir gser dngul gyi thog drangs pa'i 'bul ba rnam gzhag yang yang bsgrubs pa dang / rgyun du yang mtshan nyid pa phal mo che rnams dang / sgom chen pa phal mo che rnams la rgyags gnang ba dang / dgos su'ang dge sbyor sha stag byed pa rnams la gnang sbyin mdzad pa la sogs pa ni snga phyir mtha' yas mang po mdzad pa'o/ /sbyin pa'i yul mchog ma yin pa ni/ spyir skye bo phal mo che rnams la sbyin gtong mdzad pa dang / khyad par du ma nus pa dang / bkren cing phongs pa nyams thag pa rnams la/ dngos dang lkog tu sbyin gtong mdzad pa'ang mang du byung ngo / /gnyis pa chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ chos don du gnyer ba sha stag byung na/ phyogs ris nas lhags pa'i nyams chung re re la'ang dka' gnas cher mi mdzad par 'dod chos kyis rgyud tshim par mdzad na/ dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs skye bo phal mo che dang bcas pa la/ so so'i skal ba dang 'tshams par deng sang gi bar du chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun du yang yang bskor ba smros ci dgos/ de la nyin mtshan chos kyis dus 'da' zhing bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba zhig go /gsum pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa ni/ dmag dang choms rkun dang / rgyal po'i chad pas 'jigs zhing skrag pa'i nyams thag pa phal mo che rnams dang / gzhan yang mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa phal mo che rnams la/ byin rlabs dang / stobs dang bka' lung dang chos dang zang zing gi sgo nas/ dbugs 'byin zhing 'jigs pa las thar bar mdzad pa sogs ni dpag tu med do/ /de yang gong du byon dus khrims phog pa'i nyams thag pa khri phrag mang po/ bka' lung gis khri mun las thar bar mdzad pa'i lo rgyus dang / pho brang la me shor ba'i dus su byin rlabs kyis zhi bar byas pa'i lo rgyus dang / rma chu la mi thar pa rnyog ma'i rang bzhin byin rlabs kyis dngas par byas nas thar par mdzad pa'i lo rgyus dang /

mdo stod smad du/ 'brum nad/ gdon gyis nyen pa khri phrag du ma dag rje 'di byon pa dang byin rlabs kyis zhi bar byas pa'i lo rgyus dang / mdor na mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa las thar bar mdzad pa ni mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa'o/ /bzhi pa byams pa'i sbyin pa ni/ kun la snyoms pa'i thugs kyis dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas gnas skabs dang / mthar thug gi bde ba dang / dge ba la 'god cing phan par mdzad pa kho na lhur len pa yin no/ /chos dang zang zing dpal 'byor rgya mtsho yis/ /gang la gang dgos re ba bskangs nas ni/ /slar yang lhug par gtong ba'i ngang tshul can/ /mi bzad sbyin pa'i gter chen khyod la bdud/ /gnyis pa tshul khrims la bslab pa la/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims la bslab pa/ dge ba chos bsdud kyi tshul khrims la bslab pa/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims la bslab pa gsum/ rim pa bzhin so sor thar pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la nyes ltung phra zhing phra bas ma gos shing sdom pa dang / de dag gi bslab par bya ba mtha' dag la gces spras su mdzad cing yongs su bsdud pa dang / de ltar spang bar bya ba dang / bslab par bya ba de dag thams cad gzhan gyi don 'ba' zhig gi phyir lhur len pa sha stag go /nyes ltung phra zhing phra bas ma gos zhing / /gcig tu dge ba'i mdzad spyod 'ba' zhig gis/ /gzhan gyi don la bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba/ /tshul khrims phung pos brgyan pa khyod la 'dud/ /gsum pa bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab pa ni/ log par blta zhing gshe bskur byed pa dag dang / 'khor gyi log sgrub ji snyed cig byung yang de dag la/ lhag par brtse zhing dngos sam brgyud pa'i sgo nas phan pa kho na lhur mdzad pa sha stag go /skyon bral khyod la log par sgrub pa'i tshogs/ /mthu ldan khyod kyis tshar gcod nus na yang / /brtse ldan khyod ni lhag par rjes su skyong / /rtag tu bzod pa'i ngang tshul khyod la 'dud/

/bzhi pa brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab pa ni/ spyir dge ba'i bya ba rlabs po che mtha' dag la thugs gzhol zhing 'bad med du rdzogs par nus pa dang / khyad par du nyin zhag phrugs re la sus kyang dpag par mi nus pa'i zab mo'i thugs dam gzigs rtog zhal thon/ chos 'chad pa/ rgyun gtor la sogs pa'i chos spyod kyi rim pas dus 'da' zhing / mdzad pa'i phrin las brlabs po che la skad cig kyang bsnyel ba mi mnga' zhing / tha mal du snyoms las la bzhugs pa sus kyang mthong ma myong zhing / nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' ba ni/ ding sang gi bar du kun la gsal lo/ /khyod ni rgyal sras spyod pa brlabs chen las/ /rtag tu zhum pa med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /skad cig re la ma lus rdzogs mdzad pa/ /brtson 'grus kun nas mthar son khyod la 'dud/ /lnga pa bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab pa ni/ gzhon nu nyid nas dben pa la thugs gzhol zhing spros pa thams cad ring du spangs te/ zhi gnas zab mo la ring du sbyangs shing brtan pa thob pas/ lhag mthong so sor rtog pa'i shes rab la brtse gcig tu gnas pa'i ngang nas ma g.yos par/ sngar smros pa'i mdzad pa'i phrin las de dag gis dus 'da' ba yin no/ /de'i phan yon nyams rtogs dang 'od gsal dang mngon par shes pa la sogs pa ji ltar mnga' ba ni 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /bsnyen bskur zang zing kun la ma chags shing / /dben pa'i gnas su zhi lhag zung 'brel gyis/ /ting 'dzin zab mos khyod thugs rnam par grol/ /bsam gtan mchog la mnga' brnyes khyod la 'dud/ /drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab pa ni/ yang dag pa'i lta ba phyin ci ma log pa la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad/ sgom byung gi shes rab kyis nges pa'i shes rab bskyed pas/ thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son cing sde snod gsum gyi de kho na nyid la ma rmongs shing spobs pa thogs pa med par gyur te/

skyes thob sbyangs dang sgom byung shes rab kyis/ /ji bzhin ji snyed shes bya'i gnas rnams la/ /rnam pa kun tu rmongs pa mi mnga' ba/ /shes rab rgya mtsho'i mthar son khyod la 'dud/ /de ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i ngang nas skye dgu'i tshogs phal mo che khri phrag du ma dag bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis yang dag par bsdus te/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pas rgyud smin par mdzad cing / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa brlabs po che dgra la 'god par mdzad do/ /bzhi pa rig pa 'dzin pa dang thun mong gi sku che ba'i yon tan la/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa ji ltar nod pa/ de'i bslab bya la ji ltar bslab pa gnyis/ dang po rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa ji ltar nod pa ni/ smin par byed pa dbang bskur bas thugs gtams pa ste/ rgyud sde bzhi'i nang nas bya ba'i rgyud la/ rigs gsum spyi'i dbang dang / rigs gtad phal mo che rnams dang / spyod pa'i rgyud la rnam snang mngon byang dang / 'jam dpal dpa' bo grub pa'i dbang la sogs pa phal mo che rnams dang / rnal 'byor rgyud la/ rdo rje dbyings/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dbang la sogs pa phal mo che rnams dang / rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi bskor la/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang / dpal kyai rdo rje la sogs pa phal mo che rnams dang / pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa dang / gshin rje'i gshed la sogs pa rnams dang / ma rgyud 'khor lo bde mchog mnyam sbyor/ sgyu ma chen mo la sogs pa rnams te/ rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang bsam gyis mi khyab pas thugs rgyud smin par mdzad do/ /rab 'byams rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor cher zhugs nas/ /dbang dang rjes gnang rig gtad la sogs pa/ /dam tshig sdom pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su gtams/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso bo khyod la 'dud/ /gnyis pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i bslab bya la ji ltar bslab pa ni/

lung la bslab pa dang / mngon par rtogs pa la bslab pa gnyis/ dang po ni rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i rgyud/ bstan bcos man ngag phal mo che rab 'byams gsan pa'i tshul ni/ rje 'di nyid kyi gsan yig chen mo las rtogs par bya'o/ /rab 'byams rgyud dang man ngag mdzod 'dzin pa/ /mkhas grub rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshogs rnams las/ /rgyud dang man ngag gsan zhing thugs su chud/ /gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mthar son khyod la 'dud/ /mngon par rtogs pa la ji ltar bslab pa la/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor la bslab pa/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor la bslab pa/ de'i yan lag spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la ji ltar mdzad pa gsum las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ spyir me tog phog pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor mang po'i bsgom bzlas la brtson zhing / khyad par du thugs dam nar ma la kyai rdo rje/ bde mchog gshed dmar la sogs pa'i phyag len mang du mdzad/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ spyir bsam gyis mi khyab na'ang / 'khrul 'khor/ rlung sbyor/ thig le'i rnal 'byor/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor/ bde ba sgom pa'i rjes la blta ba skyong ba/ rmi lam dang 'od gsal 'dzin pa la sogs pa rgyun du mdzad pa'i thugs dam du ma zhig mnga' la/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka'i thun mong du lam dus len pa/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bir srung la sogs pa bka' rgyas btab pa mang du snang / de dag gi yan lag spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la/ bzlas pa/ gtor ma/ sbyin sreg nyal ba/ ldang ba/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor la sogs pas dus 'da' zhing / ma gdams pa'i kun spyod tha mal du bzhugs pa skad cig kyang mi mnga' 'o/ /zab mo'i lam gyis khyod thugs rnam grol zhing / /rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor zung du 'brel/ /rnam pa kun tu g.yo ba med pa'i ngang / /ting 'dzin zab mo mnga' brnyes khyod la 'dud/ /spyi'i rnam par thar pa la/

dge ba'i bshes bsnyen ji ltar brten pa'i tshul/ lung gi yon tan gyi rnam grangs dang bcas pa/ mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi rnam grangs/ gnas skabs su ngo mtshar ba'i bltas ji ltar byung tshul gyi rnam grangs dang gsum/ dang po ni/ tshigs su bcad pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa mtshungs med chos kyi rje/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan lhag par gus brten nas/ /khyed kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa nod/ /de bzhin rgyal sras rig 'dzin sgor zhugs nas/ /smin par byed pa dbang gis rgyud sbyangs shing / /grol lam rnal 'byor bzhi yi bskyed rim dang / /rdzogs pa'i rim pa shin tu spros med sogs/ /yan lag bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gsan/ /gzhan yang kyai rdo rje rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /bshad srol rnam gnyis cha lag dang bcas pa/ /sa chen bla ma'i bka' 'bum la sogs rnams/ /gsan nas rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol lo/ /nyid kyi yab gcig lnga rig paṇ+ḍi ta/ /ta dben chen po chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / /bla ma chen po bsod nams blo gros la/ /gzhon nu'i dus su rgyal sras sdom pa nod/ /ta dben gau shrī kun dga' rin chen la/ /nyid kyis tshangs spyod rab byung sdom pa nod/ /bla ma chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /nye bar bsnyen nas gsang ba 'dus pa dang / /rigs bsdus la sogs dkyil 'khor cher zhugs nas/ /lung sogs chos kyi rnam grangs du ma nod/ /gzhon nu'i dus na kun mkhyen gangs grags pa dpal khrod pas/ /byin gyis brlabs shing lung bstan rten 'brel bsgrigs/ /mkhas grub chen po rin chen rdo rje la/ /rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub la sogs gsan/ /bka' drin mnyam med ma ti paṇ+ḍi ta/ /bsnyen nas rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel pa yi/ /dbang dang byin rlabs du mas rgyun smin cing / /mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnam grangs du ma dang / /zhi byed phyag chen nā ro chos drug sogs/ /yongs su grags pa'i gdams pa rab 'byams gsan/

/dpal ldan rgyud 'dzin phyogs las jo mo nang pa rnam rgyal la/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor cher zhugs nas/ /rgyud rgyal zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sogs/ /yan lag bcas pa gsan zhing thugs su chud/ /sgra bsgyur chen po byang chub rtse mo la/ /theg chen lam gyi dngos gzhi blo sbyong dang / /'phags pa'i bka' srol dpal ldan 'dus pa yi/ /sgor zhugs rim pa lnga yi gdams pa sogs/ /rnam grangs du mas khyod thugs rnam par grol/ /'phags sa bzang pa'i mtshan mnga' mkhas gzhon nu blo gros zer grub rin po che/ /nye bar bsnyen nas gsung ngag rin po che/ /dbang dang byin brlabs lam bskor dang bcas pa/ /shangs pa'i gser chos rnam bzhi la sogs nod/ /mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug grags zer sa skya bu ston pa/ /nye bar brten nas dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /bka' srol phyag bzhes dbang dang byin rlabs dang / /man ngag la sogs rnam grangs du ma nod/ /khyad par du yang kyai rdo rje yi/ /rgyud gsum bshad srol zung gis brgyan pa dang / /gzhung shing bzhis dkri gsung ngag rin po che/ /lam bskor dang bcas gsan zhing thugs su chud/ /mkhyen ldan thos pa rgya mtsho'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /gnyag ston byang chub seng ge zhes bgyi ba/ /khyod kyis rnam pa kun tu nyer brten nas/ /dbang dang byin brlabs man ngag du ma dang / /gzhan yang kha ba can du 'gyur ro cog /bka' dang bstan bcos de 'grel bcas pa'i lung / /blo bzang khyod kyis ngom pa med par gsan/ /ston pa gang des dpe mkhyud med par gdams/ /gnas brtan chen po rgyal ba bzang po pa/ /nye bar brten nas dbang dang rjes gnang dang / /gzhan yang chos kyi rnam grangs du ma gsan/ /sdom brtson dam pa mkhas grub khyung po pa/ /nye bar bsnyen nas bya ba spyod pa'i rgyud/ /khyad par rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sgor zhugs nas/ /rdo rje dbyings sogs rnam grangs du ma gsan/

/'od gsal thogs med sgrub chen byams pa dpal/ /gus pas brten nas khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i/ /bka' srol byin brlabs zhal gdams phal cher gsan/ /gzhan yang sde snod 'dzin pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /lung dang rigs pa'i rnam grangs du ma gsan/ /zhes pa ltar rtogs par bya'o/ /khyad par du kun mkhyen gsang khrod pa dang 'jal bzhed pa'i tshe/ de'i tho rangs kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa'i rnal lam du/ tshes bco lnga'i zla ba rgyang shar ba rmi/ sad pa dang nye gnas rnams la/ de ring las can skal can cig yong ba'i bltas gcig byung bas su byung yang 'phrad kha thongs gsung / de 'phral du rje 'dis phebs pas shin tu dges/ slob dpon chen po la chos gang 'dod 'bul gsung na'ang / de dus rnam 'grel gyi slob gnyer gyi sgang yin pas/ gsan pa'i skabs ma byung gsung / der kun mkhyen gangs khrod pas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gser sku legs pa gcig gnang / thugs rab kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs/ de phyin chad sngar bas thugs 'dzin bzang bar song ba'i lo rgyus gsung / yang bla gos legs pa gcig gnang / sdom brtson tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ ding sang rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs pa stong phrag du ma'i mkhan po mdzad nas tshul khrims mthar phyin pa 'di la blta ba yin gsung ngo / /yang stan dmar legs pa gcig gnang / kun gyis bskur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/ /zhes gsung / gnyis pa mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi rnam grangs la gsum/ bla ma dang yid dam zhal gzigs shing lung bstan tshul/ mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong gis bka' nod tshul/ ting nge 'dzin dang mngon par shes pa la mnga' brnyes tshul lo/ /dang po bla ma dang yi dam gyi zhal gzigs tshul ni/ byang rwa sgreng du zla ba lnga sku 'tshams dam po la bzhugs pa'i dus su/ tho rangs gcig rnal lam du rje thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gzim khang yin zer ba'i khang bzang dbu rtse rnying ma bskor las cung che ba/

zhal la ser po legs par byas pa gcig 'dug rje thams cad mkhyen pa'ang bzhugs nas 'dug ste/ rje'i zhal nas khang pa 'di'i bdag po la khyed bsko ba yin gsungs nas gnang ba gcig rmi/ de'i mod la mnal sad/ de 'phral du bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom nas gsol ba btab pas/ tho rangs nas nyi ma phyed kyi bar du rje bla ma nyid na bza' jus ngur kha'i zla kham/ dbu zha lhab zha mdzad pa gsal po mngon sum lta bur byung / ting nge 'dzin de la 'byams/ gzhan yang byin rlabs kyi 'jug sgo ngo mtshar ba 'ga' zhig byung zhes rje nyid gsung / de'i nyin par 'bri khung pa dang / nyan po dgon pa ba'i gdan 'dren 'dzoms nas rmi lam gyi rten 'brel gcig gis nyan por phyin par bzang par 'dug pas/ nyan po ba la khas blangs pa yin gsungs/ de nas bzung ste/ 'phan yul gyi sa char rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi chos brgyud dang phrin las dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ /yang sa skya'i dbu rtse rnying mar lo gsum sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs pa'i dus su tho rangs mnal lam du/ rje sa skya pa chen po dang 'jal/ g.yam leb la sa dkar gyis bris pa'i bcu grangs kyi tshad tsam gyi pu sti zhig gnang nas/ 'di rnams khyod kyi blo la zungs shig gsungs/ blo la bzung bas dga' snang la tshad med pa byung ba'i ngang las/ rje sa chen snying khar thim nas song / de'i mod la mnal sad tsam na/ dang po khams bde rig pa dngas pa byung pa la/ de nas yun dum tsam gcig song tsa na lus po thams cad zi ber langs nas na/ yang gnyid du song gda' tsa na/ nad de med par sngar pas khams dngas shing ting nge 'dzin gsal po byung / dga' snang khyad par can skyes/ des rkyen byas nas rje btsun gong ma yab sras rnams kyi bka' 'bum bzhengs pa'i blo skyes pa yin gsungs/ yang gnas de nyid du sku mtshams la bzhugs pa'i dus su/ tho rangs gcig mnal lam du g.yabs chen na/ rje btsun chen pos rgyud gsum ka gsung pa'i khri gcig yod pas/

de'i steng du rje sa skya pa chen po dang / rje btsun chen po gnyis ka bzhugs 'dug pa dang mjal nas phyag phul pas/ thig khang byang ma ding sang 'phags pa rin po che'i sku lder bzhugs pa'i sgo nang de nas kyang khye'u gzhon nu shin tu mdzes pa rgyan mang pos brgyan pa 'od zer 'phro bzhin pa gcig byung / de la rje sa chen gyi zhal nas 'di yang 'o cag gi mi yin ngo shes par gyis shig gsungs nas/ nga khye'u de la ngo sprad pa cig rmis/ khye'u de 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin nges par 'dug gsungs/ yang lha khang chen po ru sku khams bsnyel ba'i tshul bstan pa'i dus/ rje sa skya pa chen po dngos su byon/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag dang mchod pa phul/ mos gus tshad med pa 'khrungs/ zhabs drung du 'byon par gsol ba btab pas/ rje sa chen nyid zhal 'dzum pa gcig mdzad/ brgyang je ring je ring la song / mthar mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas lo gsum bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel yin par mngon/ de la sogs pa rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi zhal gzigs shing lung bstan pa dang / rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i lo rgyus mang du gnang ngo / /lhag pa'i lha zhal gzigs shing lung bstan byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul ni/ kha rag tu bzhugs dus de'i bskor brag nag po gcig gi dkyil na/ brag dkar po bco lnga'i zla ba 'dra ba gcig yod/ de'i mdun na gdengs kha legs po gcig yod pas/ der snga dro tshogs mchod byed pa'i gnas byas nas mdun bskyed bsgrub pa'i skabs su song tsa na/ nyams 'ur nas dran pas yang yang 'dzin dgos pa byung / ting nge 'dzin gsal stong gi shugs chen po tshad med pa skyes/ de'i ngang la mdun gyi nam mkha' thams cad khengs pa'i rje btsun kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du yun ring por mthong / gnas der/ dge sbyor la bogs chen po byung ba yin gsungs/ yang dbu rtse rnying ma'i gzim khang du sku mtshams la bzhugs pa'i dus/

a ra pa tsa na'i bsnyen pa bye ba phrag gcig btang / de'i dus su nam mkha' thams cad dkyil 'khor rigs mi gcig pa mang pos gang ba yang nas yang du mthong gsungs/ yang ngam rings su a ra pa tsa na'i bsnyen pa 'jur po re mdzad pas thugs rab la thogs pa med pa nang nas 'khrungs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs shing 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa 'di yang de dus mdzad do/ /yang rmi lam du lha khang bla brang gi gzim khang rang 'dra ba gcig na/ gtso bo bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang du bzhengs pa shin tu dngas pa gcig 'dug de la mos gus skyes nas phyag 'tshal gyin yod pas/ de'i 'khor bud med dmar tshal ma gcig lan bu la bltas nas/ ka ra ka ra la sogs pa'i gzungs bzla yin glu len pi waṃ bsgyur ba'i snyan pa'i gdangs bsam gyis mi khyab pas yid bsgyur ba dang / yang bud med gzhon nu la lha'i gos sna tshogs pas klubs pa gcig gis gar sna mi gcig pa mtha' yas pa bsgyur/ bu mo gcig gis me 'bud kyin 'dug pa yun ring po'i bar du byung gsung ngo / /yang rin chen sgang bla brang du rje thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa la gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gsan pa'i dus su rje nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed dmar po mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gtso bo'i rnam pa mngon sum du yun ring por gzigs/ yang zhal nas byang rwa sgreng du mtshams la yod dus gshed dmar lnga'i lus dkyil 'god lugs 'di kun gsal snang la byung ba yin te dus phyis slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyi rgya gzhung dang gcig rang du 'dug da lta 'di'i byin rlabs byed tsa na/ nga la nges shes 'grongs ting pa yod gsung ngo / /yang ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs pa'i dus/ ngo mtshar ba'i bltas tshigs su bcad pa/ lho ri'i ngos la gdan bteg ste/ /mkha' la 'ja' 'od phreng ba'i tshogs/

/'khrigs pa bzhin dang 'bar ba bzhin/ /'khyil ba bzhin dang bsnol ba bzhin/ /bris pa bzhin dang 'khyug pa bzhin/ /gsal ba bzhin dang dngas pa bzhin/ /lham pa bzhin dang bkra ba bzhin/ /'od zer blta na gdug pa'i tshogs/ /phyogs rnams kun tu khyab par gyur/ /nub ri'i rtse la phebs pa'i tshe/ /'ja' gur kun nas 'khyil pa'i dbus/ /rje nyid 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor bcas/ /dpal ldan gzi 'od lham mer 'bar/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /kun tu gsal la thogs pa med/ /bsam gtan bde bas dges dgur rol/ /sa 'dzin de yi byang gi char/ /a ru ra yi brag phug nas/ /ston zla rgyas pa'i kha dog bzhin/ /'ja' 'od dkar gsal 'khyug pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor khor yug rim par bskor/ /slar yang mkha' la bsgrengs pa'i rtser/ /kha dog sna tshogs cher 'bar ba/ /zlum po dang ni gru bzhi dang / /zla gam dang ni gru gsum dang / /de bzhin 'od kyi thig le dag /skar ma bzhin du 'khrigs pa dang / /khye 'u dang ni bu mo dang / /rta dang glang po srog chags gzugs/ /'bar ba bzhin du lham mer gsal/ /byang ri bgrod dkar 'gro ba gang / /gzhan dag grang ba'i reg byas 'joms/ /rlung dang kha ba bu yug 'tshubs/ /rje nyid phebs tshe ngo mtshar bltas/ /sngon med nam mkha' dngas pa dang / /sprin med nyi ma gsal ba dang / /zag med ting 'dzin bde la rol/ /sa 'dzin de yi byang gi char/ /yan lag brgyad ldan chu yi rgyun/ /gzhan dag 'bad pas bsgrubs na yang / /skam zhing mthong bar mi nus na/ /btung byar 'os pa smros ci 'tshal/ /rje nyid sngon gyi smon lam mthus/ /lha yi yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ /mi zad pa yi btung ba dag /'khor dang bcas pas ci dgar rol/ /rje nyid shar rir phebs pa'i tshe/ /rgya bod 'dus pa'i tshogs dang bcas/ /'ja' 'od kun nas 'khyil pa'i dbus/ /lha dbang bzhin du brjid pa dang / /nye dbang bzhin du 'dud pa dang / /dri za bzhin du sgrogs par snang /

/gzhan yang 'ja' gur rim pa dag /'od kyi drwa ba 'khrigs pas sgrol/ /de dag gi ni bar bar na/ /dang ba'i chu nang zla ba bzhin/ /drang srong 'khar ba thogs pa dang / /seng ge kun nas 'gying ba dang / /glang chen dal bus rol ba dang / /khye 'u spyod lam mdzes pa dang / /ri dwags kun nas sgeg pa dang / /lha bu gdugs dang rgyal mtshan sogs/ /rol pas phyag rnams brel ba dang / /dbang sngon gzhu ba'i thigs pa bzhin/ /ral gri sngon po 'bar ba dag /shar ri'i rtse nas nub ri'i bar/ /drang srong kun gyis mthong ba dang / /chu skyes kha dog sna tshogs gzugs/ /steng gi mkha' la 'khrigs pa dang / /gzhan yang rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pa/ /shar ri'i ngos la gsal bar gyur/ /slar yang dben par bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /mkhyen ldan mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan ma nges pa/ /rnam 'phrul sna tshogs gzigs par gyur/ /gzhan yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /shin tu gsal ba'i gtsug tor dbus/ /rta mgo ljang khu rngog ma dmar/ /dwangs shing gsal bas mtshan pa gcig /nyin mtshan kun tu gzigs zhes gsung / /de 'dra brjod na grangs las 'das/ /bri yis lang ba med ces gsung / /mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong gi bka' nod tshul ni/ zhal nas dbu rtser bzhugs dus rmi lam du/ mthil gyi gtsug lag khang na mgon po nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa gcig dang por mthong ba la/ de nas de res 'ga' phyag bzhi pa/ res 'ga' phyag drug pa sogs rnam 'gyur bsam gyis mi khyab par ston bzhin pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gcig tu 'gyur zhing 'gyur zhing song / de mthong bas chos skyong thams cad ngo bo gcig pa yin snyam pa'i nges shes skyes gsung / yang ngam rings su mtshams dam po byas/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i bsnyen pa byed pa'i dus su nyi ma lhag te shar tsa na/ lha mo dpon g.yog gnyis dre'u nag po la zhon nas bar snang la sha ra ra byung / mos gus byas phyag 'tshal ring la mi 'dug

lha mo 'di ngas lan mang po mthong / yang lha khang bla brang na yod dus dpon po ri'i rtse mo la shar nas brgyangs kyis byung / lha mo'i dre'u la gom shags gcig yod pa lags tshal tshal yod par 'dug gsung / yang dbu rtse na mtshams dam po la yod pa'i dus su/ gsol ja khang par tsha ba byas pa'i rjes su gnyid kyang ma yin pa'i nyams snang gcig la mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod bdag po ru ṭa pho mo gnyis gar stabs ling ling rnam 'gyur ci rigs byed par mthong / de dus dge sbyor 'phel ba'i sgang yin pas dge sbyor gyi shugs chen po yod gsungs/ pu tra 'di deng sang cha lugs 'gyur 'dug gsung ba dang / 'di deng sang gzi brjid che bar 'dug chung bar 'dug gsung ba sogs gang yin mngon sum du gzigs shing phran du 'khol ba yin no/ /yang byang rwa sgreng du chos skyong gi bsnyen pa bskyel zhing mtshams la yod pa'i dus su/ nyams snang la mi nag gcig gis ras phyam gyis gtum pa gcig khur nas 'dug ci yin snyam tsa na mi ru 'dug ste gtor ma'i 'gram du bzhag byung / de la ched du gtad nas bltas tsa na mtho gang tsam du 'gro zhing / de khar bzhag tsa na li dang bong ge mnyam par 'dug de'i nyin par/ rwa sgreng gi phu na bla ma phyug po/ 'bri khung ba gcig 'dug pa de byung nas der nged la ja bskol bya/ rten khebs gcig phul nas gnam zer la phan pa'i gdams ngag 'dra yod de gnang bar zhu zer/ de dus nged kyang thang po las med pa dang / bsgrub mchod byed pa'i chas rnams ma 'grig par yod pas/ 'tsho chas kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs par snang ste/ dge sbyor la gnod snyam nas gdams ngag ma byas/ de byas na gnyis ka la phan nges par 'dug pa lags gsungs/ gzhan yang gzhi bdag la sogs pas bka' nod tshul ni/ zhal nas nged kha rag tu bsgrub pa la phyin dus der sleb tu cha ba dang / bar snang la rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i bud med kyi rta pa gsum phar rgyug tshur rgyug byed pa mngon sum du mthong /

kha rag khyung btsun ma mo dga' nas bsu ba byed pa yin par 'dug de'i rjes thogs la skyes pa gcig gis zho brdze gcig khyer bu mo skran khyer ma gcig khrid byung nas/ byin rlabs zhu zer/ byin rlabs byas pas de 'phral du mo'i nad zug zhi/ de gzhi bdag gi cho 'phrul yin par shes nas/ 'bul ba yang blangs gsungs/ yang gsung gi kha rag tu zla ba lnga'i bar du bsdad/ de'i mtshams su sgrub pa po rin chen rgya mtshos mgo byas 'khor rnams na re/ mi nyung ba'i dus 'dir lha sar gshegs pa 'thad zer nas zhu ba nan byed du byung / nged la dge sbyor 'phel po byung bas bsdod 'dod kyang khong tsho ma nyan par chas pa'i dus su/ rmi lam du bud med mdzes mas phyag 'tshal nas/ bla ma khyed cis kyang bzhugs par zhu zhes zhu ba 'bul du byung / de nas lam du zhugs pa'i dus su yang phyag 'tshal zhing zhu 'bul yang yang byas bshol 'debs su byung / bshol ma thebs pa dang / a'u tsam a zer nas mgo gug pa gcig byas song / de bzhin du sgrub pa pos kyang mthong 'dug der nged la 'dzo mo gsum yod pa'i zho bzang shos rang de rbab du 'gril nas shi/ ma bsdad pas mo ma dga' ba'i cho 'phrul du 'dug gsungs/ yang zhal nas kha rag gi stod/ dam pa phug zer ba'i rje dam pa sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs sa de la byas/ dngos su sngags pa bag dron skra dpung pa gnyis su nyil le sleb pa gcig byung nas/ khyed 'dir ci la 'ongs zer/ gnas bskor ra yin byas pas/ gnas bskor nas ci byed zer/ rig pa'i rtsal sbyong ba yin byas pas khong 'dzum mul byas phyag gcig btsal nas gar song cha med la song / de'ang gzhi bdag gi cho 'phrul du snang gsung / gong nas phebs/ ngam rings pas gdan 'dren zhus/ gzhis chen nas 'degs dus/ si tu chos grags pa yab sras kyis thogs drangs/ skya khrom gyi bsu ba mtshan cher yod pa'i dkyil na/ bar phug gi rgyal po de'ang spre'u chen po gcig gis rta sna khrid byas nas bsu ba la sleb 'dug gsung /

de la sogs pa mtha' yas so/ /mdor na 'jig rten pa'i lha 'dre dang / mi ma yin thams cad kyang gdug rtsub kyi bsam pa dang bral nas/ skyel bsu zhabs tog bsgrub cing 'dud pa kho na yin no/ /gsum pa ting nge 'dzin dang mngon par shes pa la mnga' brnyes tshul ni/ rje nyid skabs 'gar ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus gsol ba la sogs pa zhu ba'i skabs kyang mi rnyed par ting nge 'dzin la song ba dang / nyin zhag bdun la sogs par ting nge 'dzin gcig la 'byams pa'i lo rgyus mang du yod do/ /de yang jo mo nang du zla ba drug tsam sku mtshams dam pa la bzhugs pas rlung stod 'tshang thu mo rang gcig byung / der de la dmigs nas 'khrul 'khor dang / dmigs pa sogs gdams ngag gis bcun pas/ nad de dang po thu ru song / de nas bem ste song / de nas sngar na ba'i sa der bde drod skyes te/ sangs kyis phan/ phyis ye nas na ma myong gsungs/ bsnyen sgrub dang lam 'bras kyi gegs sel gnang ba'i dus su 'di bzhin byas na 'di tsug byas na bde drod skye/ rjes la na ba mi yong gda' ste/ kho kun 'dras nyams su myong bar yod 'dug gsung ba yang 'di 'dra la dgongs pa yin no/ /yang lha khang bla brang na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ bsnyen sgrub kyi thig le'i rnal 'byor 'dren 'grongs la nyams len sbyangs pas 'dzag pa'i gegs byung nas thugs ma bde tsa na/ nub gcig rmi lam du dam pa sangs rgyas yin zer ba'i a tsa ra 'phrug gos dkar po sang pa gyon pa gcig nam lang kha tsam la byung / khong gis 'di bzhin gyis zer ba'i brdar zhabs g.yon pa'i rting pas sgo gnyis kyi bar bsdams/ zhabs g.yas ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i bzhugs stangs su byas nas 'dren byas pas thig le steng du sha ra ra 'grongs kyin 'dug rmi lam sad nas de bzhin du 'dren byas pas shin tu gnad che bar byung / des go bcad gsung / yang bsnyen sgrub kyi 'pho ba chen mo'i yig cha brtsams zin tsa na/

ngo mtshar ba'i bltas gcig byung gsung / yang zhal nas nga bshad nyan byed tsa na/ dge sbyor gyi long lugs gcig rang yod de/ de tsam na sgom dga' mo byung ba yin gsung / yang nga gzhon pa'i dus su/ lus nyams ngag nyams sems nyams mthong nyams/ nyams bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyun du 'ong / nyams de rnams thams cad lam du 'gro ba mdzad pa ni mkhas grub 'phags pa yin te/ shin tu sku drin che bar yod gsung / mngon par shes pa la mnga' brnyes tshul ni/ sne'u bas spyan drangs nas mtshal dbus gling du dbyar bzhugs zhus/ de nas bteg nas stod lung gzhan khang du phyag phebs pa'i nub mo/ gan khang gzhis kha khang bzang yin pa dang / zhu ba nan can phul kyang / rje'i drung nas thad bsgar la bzhugs nas/ khang par ye nas 'byon du ma 'dod/ de'i nub mo sa g.yos kyis gzhis kha de 'gyel ba dang / thams cad kyis thugs mkhyen mnga' bar thag chod/ yang pha wong khar sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs dus/ rin spungs pa slob dpon nam mkha' rgyal po sku gshegs pa mkhyen nas/ zhag po bdun gyi bar du thugs dam la gtags zhag bdun 'das pa dang / slob dpon nam mkha' rgyal ba gos 'gam dkar gyon phyag gsum btsal nas/ shin tu thugs la gtags bdag bar do'i 'jigs pa las skyabs so zhes zhu ba mkhyen pa dang dus mnyam du/ mkhan po byang chub dpal gyis thugs dam la 'dogs par zhus pa dang / nged kyis khar sang du thugs dam la gtags/ bltas 'di bzhin byung / bar do gzigs par thag chod/ nyan por bzhugs dus mtshan mo yid la med/ sgrub pa po rin chen rgya mtsho bsnyung ba bskor du byon sgrub pa pos kyang chos rje 'byon pa mkhyen/ der sgrub pa po la dbang dang 'pho ba gnang bas sgrub pa po thugs rang par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang slob dpon sang she ba gshegs pa mkhyen pa la sogs pa bar do gzigs pa'i rnam thar shin tu mang ngo / /gong la byon dus mi byings po gcig gis sku nas bgres pa dang /

sngar gyi ti shrī rnams phal cher yar la ma phebs pa shas che na byung 'dug pas/ mi rnams sems ma bde nas/ phebs mi phebs ji ltar yong zhal lta zhus pas/ khyed rnams gnyid ma sad pa la ngas sleb yong / blo kyog mi dgos gsung / bod du phyag phebs dus/ rgyal po'i pho brang du mo ri la me shor ba mkhyen pa dang / dbus su khrid gnang dus khrid zhu bsam brlag gis/ rdo rje nor bu la phreng ba dkris nas rtsed mo byas pa mkhyen pa dang / gzhan yang the tshom gyi zhu ba bzhu ma nus pa/ ya ta nas zhal ta gsal por gnang ba sogs mtha' yas so/ /'od gsal zab mo'i ngang las ma g.yos par/ /gzhan gyi sems dang 'chi 'pho skye ba dang / /bar do la sogs sgrib med gsal bar gzigs/ /mngon par mkhyen pa thogs med khyed la 'dud/ /gnas skabs su ngo mtshar ba'i bltas ji ltar byung tshul ni/ gong nas gdan 'dren byung dus sku nas bgres/ spyan gnyis ka 'gribs pa bden nges su yod na'ang / chos rje gong la ma byon na phag mo gru pa la'ang / bka' bskyon brji mo phebs/ phrin las pa rnams bsgrags/ rgya'i dmag bod la yong bar thag chod 'dug pas/ dka' tshegs dang sbyong spyod gang la yang ma gzigs par byon pa 'di ni sems can gyi don dang / bod yul gyi rgyal khams bde thabs kho na la dgongs pa yin no/ /gzhan la phan na srog gtong ba la'ang ngal ba med ces gsungs/ 'brug lo zla ba bzhi pa la/ gdan sa nas gong du 'byon khar chos khri thang du/ bla ma chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa dang drung bzhi thog pas thog drangs dge 'dun khri phrag tsam la thugs bskyed gsung dus/ nam mkha' 'ja' 'od sna lngas gang zhing 'ja' dkar gyi drwa bas bsgrel ba dang / me tog gi char bu yug tu 'tshub pa tsam byung bas kun gyis ngo mtshar du bsgrog pa dang / gnya' gong / ga ju/ shing kun mkhar rnams su gong nas kyi bsu ba'i bkod pa/ rnam 'gyur rigs mi 'dra ba ngo mtshar ba du mas bsu zhing /

khyad par shing kun tu 'phags pa rin po che'i thugs dam dus gsum sangs rgyas la phyag mchod mdzad dus/ rten gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer gyi drwa ba byung ste/ rje 'di nyid la zug pa der yod kun gyis mthong zhing / de dus gong gis lung 'bul ba sleb pa dang mnyam du spyan bye/ 'ja' sa gzigs/ nam mkha' la me tog gi char babs pas kun ngo mtshar du bsgrog pa dang / pho brang du phebs nas/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong ldan phul nas chos kyi 'khor bskor bar gsol ba btab/ de mtshams su de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems la mchod pa phul/ smon lam rgya chen po mdzad/ de nas pho brang ta'i tur phebs/ gser gyi 'ja' sa bsgrags nas theg chen chos kyi rgyal po la sogs pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs du mas/ thub pa'i rgyal tshab chen por mnga' gsol/ de nas con ting hu 'di nas nub byang du sa lo bar lnga brgya phyin pa'i sa na ri bo rtse lnga yod zer/ zhes bya pho brang nas yar bod phyogs la nyi ma dgu yong pa'i sa na yod/ ba'i sde chen po/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sku 'di sngar kong tshe 'phrul rgyal bya bas rdzu 'phrul gyis bzhengs pa'i gser sku bzhengs/ sku zhal gcig pa phyag stong spyan stong gi rnam pa can ag tshoms byas pa blos mi 'khyud pa gcig 'dug go 'dom bco brgyad yod pa gcig bzhugs pa dang / 'phags pa rin po che'i sku lde sku mi tshad tsam pa dbu zha karma pa'i zhwa nag 'dra ba bzhes pa gcig 'dug go 'dra dang bcas pa la phyag mchod mdzad dus/ me tog gi char babs/ nyan por sa skya pa yab sras kyi bka' 'bum gsung dus/ 'ja' dang 'od dang sgra dang / me tog gi char zhag mang po'i bar du babs pa dang / rgya ma rin chen sgang du chos gsung dus/ me tog gi char babs pa dang / gong nas phebs pa'i phyi la/ gdan sar gzhan yang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ khyad par lam 'bras pa tshan cher 'tshogs/ bla ma'i rnam thar gsung ba'i skabs su/

rje sa chen gyi rnam thar tshugs pa'i nyin mo nas mgo btsugs te/ bsod rtse rje btsun paṇa chen 'phags pa ste/ yab sras khu dbon lnga po'i rnam thar gsung sting / zhag bdun gyi bar du me tog gi char rgyun ma chad pa babs so/ /yang ngam rings su byon/ sku 'bum rnam rgyal du phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa mdzad pa'i sgang la me tog gi char babs pa mang pos btus nas/ ga'u dang / par bu sogs su nyar tshags byas so/ /pho brang nas/ gong mas sa le bar lnga'i bar du bskyel sa le bar re la goms pa sum brgya dang dgu cu tham pa re la le bar gcig tu brtsi'i 'dug de 'dra lnga'i sar du ta'i ming rgyal pos bskyel thung mdzad 'dug go ma mdzad/ yon mchod gcig gis gcig gi phyag la 'jus shing / 'bral mi phod pa tsam du gsung gleng mdzad/ dung g.yas 'khyil rin po che du mas spras pa dang / gong ma'i mgul rgyan rin po che nyid kyi mgul nas phog ste rje la phul/ de dus sa rnam pa drug tu g.yo ba'i bltas byung ngo / /rje 'di nyid 'byung ba bzhi la dbang thob/ lha klu mi ma yin thams cad bran du 'khol zhing / dbang du 'dus pa zhig yin te/ gong la phebs dus/ bod dbus gtsang gi lha klu byings po zhabs 'bring du 'degs pa/ mdo dbus gtsang gsum gyi thugs dam pa mang pos gzigs pa'i gtam rgyud snang la/ de dang mthun par rje nyid gong du gshegs pa'i lo gsum po dbus gtsang du char ma babs/ than pa me ltar 'bar/ lung phran rnams kyi chu skam nas dkon pa sogs mi shis pa'i bltas sna tshogs byung zhing / mdo smad dang / rgya yul du de dus kyi lo gsum po de las/ char snyoms pa dang / lo legs pa sngar yong ma myong zer skad do/ /yar phebs dus rgyal khams su nad rims cung zad tsam yang ma byung zhing / phyogs na nad rims sngar than thun yod 'dug pa rnams la rje nyid kyi mtshan bsgrags pa tsam gyis zhi bar gyur to/

/dbus gtsang du de ka'i lo nas char phebs/ lo legs/ lung pa skam po thams cad nas chu rdol/ skye 'gro thams cad lus sems bde/ 'jig rten bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba ni kun la gsal lo/ /yang shangs rgyal khang du chos 'khor bskor dus/ rtse sdong phu nub na mtsho sman gcig yod pa/ chos rje bzhugs ring la/ rkug gi phur 'phos/ pha ki'i mtsho skam/ tshu khar mtsho rdol/ thams cad ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa byung ngo / /mdor na rje 'di nyid dgung lo bco lnga pa la/ dpal sa skya'i khri thog tu phebs/ 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su thub pa chen po'i rgyal tshab du mnga' gsol/ de nas bzung ste mya ngan las ma 'das kyi bar/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad/ ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan/ de ltar zhing 'di'i gdul bya phal mo che'i don mdzad pas thugs rangs par gyur pa'am/ 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du sems can gyi don rgya che bar rig pa'am/ rtag par 'dzin pa'am/ spro ba bskyed pa'am/ le lo can dag dge ba la bskul ba sogs rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas dgongs te/ lo dang zla ba/ gza' dang skar ma/ tshes dang nyi ma/ dus dang 'phrod sbyor legs par brtsis nas/ legs tshogs kyi rten 'brel mang po gcig bsgrigs te/ shing mo sbrul gyi lo gro bzhin gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu'i snga dro nyi ma shar ba'i rjes/ lha'i spos dang / me tog gi char dang / rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ bla ma dang yid dam gyi lha bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i zhal gzigs/ lha dang rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bsu ste/ rdo rje dril bu thugs khar bsnol/ dbu'i gtsug tor gsal por 'phags/ gsang ba'i gnas lta bas mi mngon pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i bltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pas/ sprul pa'i sku chos kyi dbyings su bsdus te/ dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang lha khang chen mor bde bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan to/

/de'i rjes su dad ldan 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas/ lus dang longs spyod phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pas mchod pa phul/ zhag mang po'i bar du gsol ba 'debs pa la sogs pa 'phral du rgyun du yun ring du bsgrubs/ de dag gi bar la yang 'ja' dang 'od dang rol mo'i sgra dang me tog gi char la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i bltas mang po byung ba ni kun la gsal lo/ /da lta'ang gdung gi drung du lha'i mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung zhing snang ngo / /de ltar smros pa'i rnam par thar pa 'di dag rje nyid la bka'i gnang ba zhus/ zhal las yang dang yang du gtugs/ 'dris par byas/ rang bzo dang lhag chad sgro bkur spangs te/ rje nyid kyi bran du gyur pa kun dga'i ming can gyis re shig bsdebs te/ slar yang rje nyid kyi zhabs drung yun ring brten pa'i dam pa'i grogs dag dpang du bzhag zhabs drung nyid du zhu dag byas pa yin pas thams cad yid ches par byos shig da dung rje nyid kyi zhabs la yun ring du gtugs pa'i dam pa'i grogs 'ga' zhig la ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus thos pa dang / rang nyid kyi'ang nges shes skyes pa'i lo rgyus dag yod na'ang / bkas ma gnang bas re shig ma bris so/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /bskal par bsdebs kyang brjod par mi nus pa'i/ /'dren pa nyid kyi yon tan mi zad gter/ /skal dman bdag 'dras spyod par ga la nus/ /de lta mod kyis zhing 'di'i gdul bya la/ /mi yi gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /rnam par thar pa mdo tsam bsdebs pa 'di/ /dad ldan rnams kyis ring nas bskul te sbyar/ /dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /lus can kun gyis bla ma'i zhabs brtan cing / /phrin las rgya mtsho'i rjes su rab zhugs te/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang thob par shog /theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar/

kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul nye bar mtshon byed/ ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i gter zhes bya ba 'di/ rje nyid kyi zhabs pad yun ring du brten pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos rgyal rin chen pa la sogs pa dam pa'i grogs mang po dag gis snga mo nas bskul ba dang / dus phyis rje nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa mnga' ba bstan pa rin po che'i sgron me thugs kyi sras glang thang spyan snga ba'i zhal snga nas yang dang yang du bskul nas/ zil gnon gyi lo dpyid zla ra ba la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por bsdebs pa'o/ /'dis gdul bya dpag tu med pa la phan thog par gyur cig sku gdung sngar ril por bzhugs pas/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas byung ba rnams rjes su bri bar bya'o// //shubhaṃ// / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 28 kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bkra shis kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i gter/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 27
